text:
Foreboding


Foreboding is that long shadow

that little by little advances over

        the grass

when the sun abandons its empires...


Foreboding is the faint whisper

that runs through the fearful grass

        to tell it that night is coming.

translation.title: Foreboding
translation.editorial_note: The catalog title differs, but the visible body is 'Foreboding'; the source credits Carlos López Narváez's Spanish version.
